title: ODN-11 re-bless verified at the byte level: 8 light demos byte-identical modulo catalog_hash; qos/qos_emphasis genuine contention; ecmp hash-only
evidence: From the 8ece056..ffc9b7b diff of goldens/flow.t1: `-catalog_hash c403567796188e5b` / `+catalog_hash afe505119369d195` with every per-tick line re-rolled at equal line counts (@@ -3,65 +3,65 @@; 120 changed lines = 60 ticks x add+remove, no insertions/deletions). serialize.odin writes `w_u64(&w, state.catalog_hash)` into the T1 hash input, so a header change mechanically re-rolls every per-tick hash. catalog.odin folds the balance bytes: `fold(&h, src.balance)`. Experiment at ffc9b7b: restored 8ece056's balance.json bytes in a scratch worktree (new keys defaulted to 6/512, validation bypassed), `harness save boot flow win lose draw bundle place demolish` regenerated T1s byte-IDENTICAL to 8ece056; `save qos qos_emphasis` differ (genuine contention shift); `save ecmp` identical (hash-only).
detail: Verification result, not a defect: documented re-bless reasons (a) catalog_hash drift and (c) contention shifts hold at the byte level; ecmp shows no genuine shift despite the spec's 'expected: ecmp' — zero unaccounted drift; qos_contention.t1 is new as documented.
recommended_fix: None — verification only. The golden-chunk lens may rely on this byte-identity result instead of re-deriving it.
